attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the internal NTP time source (chrony, local stratum 10, allow 10.100.87.0/24) and node2 as a client synchronizing exclusively against node1 (chrony server 10.100.87.10 iburst, no public pools). Verified sync end-to-end, then restarted node1 and node2 one at a time (preserving the other's availability), confirming boot-identity change and full chrony recovery/re-sync after each restart.
